headlines.text: Back on this day in 2021, Adam Page vs. Bryan Danielson clashed for the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 9.53 ? one of the greatest matches in company history. For Bryan Danielson, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. An instant classic, rated five stars by multiple outlets ? both men bled and threw everything they had at each other across a full 60 minutes, with Page's Buckshot Lariat landing just as time expired, an epic that ended in an unresolved draw.

Flash back to 2023, when Top Flight & Andretti vs. Komander, Penta & Vikingo closed out Rampage, rated 8.47 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle in a chaotic six-man affair, part of the special Winter is Coming '23 - Night 2 card.
Turning the clock back to 2023: it was Ross von Erich's first night in AEW, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.49.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2021, when MJF vs. Dante Martin clashed with the Dynamite Diamond Ring at stake, topping the bill that night on Dynamite, rated 6.17 ? part of a stacked Winter is Coming '21 card, rated 8.65 overall.
2023 brought us this moment: it marked the first-ever meeting between Anna Jay and Red Velvet on Rampage, rated 4.49.
